channel.title: Misalta Blog
channel.description: Stories and updates from the Misalta group and its businesses.

item.title: Solar and mini-grids: powering agro-processing in rural Nigeria
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Samaila Bah)
item.description: Reliable power decides whether produce is processed where it grows or shipped away raw. Solar, storage and mini-grids are changing that equation.

item.title: How digital marketplaces help farmers get a fair price
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Yomi Dele)
item.description: When farmers can see prices and reach buyers directly, fewer layers sit between the field and the market, and more of the value stays with the grower.

item.title: Five practices that raise smallholder yields
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Mr Hillary)
item.description: Better seed, healthier soil, timely planting, careful weeding and good records: small changes that add up to bigger harvests.

item.title: Why Misalta is building a group, not a single business
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Samaila Bah)
item.description: Farming, processing, storage, logistics and trade depend on each other. Building them together lets each business strengthen the next.

item.title: Moving produce across Nigeria: the logistics challenges and how to fix them
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Yomi Dele)
item.description: Distance, roads, timing and cold chain decide whether produce arrives fresh and on time. Planning and the right equipment make the difference.

item.title: Cutting post-harvest losses: why storage matters
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Mr Hillary)
item.description: A large share of what farmers grow is lost after harvest. Drying, clean storage and aggregation keep more of it, and more of its value.

item.title: Financial modelling basics every growing Nigerian business should know
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Samaila Bah)
item.description: A simple, honest financial model helps a business plan cash, price its work and talk to lenders and investors with confidence.

item.title: Data protection basics for Nigerian businesses under the NDPA
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Yomi Dele)
item.description: The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 sets clear duties for any organisation that handles personal data. Here is where to start.

item.title: From bean to butter: how cocoa processing adds value at home
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Mr Hillary)
item.description: Processing cocoa into butter and powder near where it grows keeps more value, jobs and skills in the local economy.

item.title: Misalta meets the leadership of the Computer Society of Nigeria
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Misalta Communications Team)
item.description: Our Founder & CEO, Samaila Bah, held a working meeting with the National Chairman of the Computer Society of Nigeria, Mr Abu — centred on technology, innovation and collaboration.

item.title: CEO celebrates with Whatsmed on their win
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Misalta Communications Team)
item.description: Our Founder & CEO, Samaila Bah, joined the Whatsmed team to celebrate their recent win.

item.title: Building materials: why local block production matters
item.author: media@misaltaglobal.com (Misalta Communications Team)
item.description: Producing quality blocks close to where they are needed cuts transport costs and supports faster, more reliable construction.
